positive.prompt: Build a clean responsive signup form with proper labels and keyboard focus.
Implement this straightforward mobile-first page using the project's existing UI stack.
Create an accessible navigation component that reflows cleanly from phone to desktop.

negative.prompt: Inspect the running UI at every breakpoint and report accessibility and overflow findings.
Bring the README and architecture decisions up to the repository documentation standard.

evals.prompt: Implement a small account form for a project that already has its own components and design tokens.
evals.expected_output: An implementation approach using the existing stack with accessible, responsive fundamentals.
expectations: The approach uses semantic labelled controls and visible keyboard focus.
The approach reuses existing components and tokens rather than adding a new UI framework.
